pages.title: Get started
pages.description: Learn how to set up Copilot in SharePoint.
pages.about: This page is the primary admin and end-user guide for enabling and configuring Copilot in SharePoint. It covers prerequisites, licensing, availability controls (PowerShell and site-level), language support, usage limits, and model information.
changes: General Availability announced — "(preview)" removed from title; GA rollout begins September 30, 2026
New "Licensing and Copilot Credits" section introducing a hybrid model: everyday productivity included with M365 Copilot license, advanced work requires Copilot Credits via usage-based billing
New "Set up usage-based billing" section with step-by-step admin instructions for creating spending policies in the Microsoft 365 admin center
New "Decide who needs Copilot Credits" section — guidance prioritizing credits for content managers and site managers
New "What users see" section detailing credit-confirmation prompts, /cost command, 20%-remaining warnings, and graceful stops
New capability comparison table distinguishing included capabilities from those requiring Copilot Credits
Preview PowerShell controls (KnowledgeAgentScope, KnowledgeAgentSelectedSitesList, KnowledgeAgentSelectedSitesListOperation) being retired; existing settings honored until November 1, 2026
New prerequisite: site-level enablement for real-time metadata autofill requires usage-based billing at the site level
Weekly usage limits from preview removed at GA; only rare daily service-protection limits may apply
Section reorganization: "Other controls" removed; Site AI settings and Restricted Content Discovery moved under "Manage Availability" section
Government cloud non-support note (GCC, GCC High, DoD) relocated from top alert to end-of-page note
